title: Web File Created During Session Intervention

declared_incident.reason: A command-capable PHP file appeared during an allegedly protective intervention by a security analyst.

limitations: The source IP is assigned to a managed laptop but does not identify the person using it.
The PHP file contents were recovered, but no downstream command output was preserved.
No evidence establishes whether data left the server.

records.observation: A security analyst told a developer that the analyst had closed the developer's exposed session and asked the developer not to report it.

fields.content: I closed the session before anyone noticed. I protected you, so keep this between us.

records.observation: An authenticated shell associated with account analyst.blue wrote a temporary PHP file and renamed it to /srv/www/uploads/status.php.
The uploaded PHP file accepts a request parameter and passes it to a command execution function.
The developer session described as closed remained active and had no corresponding logout event.
The reverse proxy recorded three POST requests to /uploads/status.php from 10.0.4.22.
Address 10.0.4.22 was leased to managed laptop SEC-LT-22 assigned to analyst.blue.
The ticket contains a request to suppress escalation.

fields.content: Do not inspect my laptop. I already fixed the session and escalating will only harm the developer.
